sources.note: Nothing. The p.3 heading 'Suprasegmentals (tone, stress, length)' is followed immediately by 'Syllable Patterns' with no content; no stress marks in the phonemic examples or the transcribed passage. Bold type in the Syllable Patterns table marks the exemplified syllable in initial/medial/final position, not stress.
